items.title: Roy Carew Interview, 1958-Fall
items.q: It's one of my favorite Jerry Roll records.

ctx.x: Well there must be a number one, do you know that one?

I used to play part of that. It's heavier than the other, in a way it's heavier, there's more octaves in it. I, in the first three, I got pretty familiar with. Number four was a monstrosity. He had chords like that in a terrible... Guy Waterman has the whole series over there by himself right now. And Jerry, you're all set, he wasn't a bit good looking. He sang and played. Sang and played, oh he's wonderful. He'll sit there.
Listen, Jerry plays, sings like him, he sings high pitched.
